title: Code & Demo Night
seo_title: Code & Demo Night at eFactory in Springfield, MO
description: Code & Demo Night is a monthly meetup where groups demo what they have worked on during the month, then split up to keep working on their projects. Pizza is provided, and newcomers can learn about projects to contribute to, with organizers available to help place them one-on-one. It takes place Tuesday, November 24, 2026 at 6:30 PM at eFactory in the Perch, 405 N Jefferson Ave, Springfield, MO.
